header: Pull the published week into your own systems
bodytext:
Every rota, clock-in and absence record is available over a REST API. You create the token yourself and can revoke it without calling us. Each token has its own rate limit, so a new integration does not slow down an older one.

Webhooks fire when a week is published, when hours are approved and when a published shift changes. That is usually enough to keep a second system in sync without polling.
caption: GET /v2/sites/{id}/rota
